_comment: Maps TaskTile rns_ai_only manifest leaf paths -> processor doc_fields field_keys, per SBIQ category id. Used by the authoritative-fill step (shared/tasktile_docfields.resolve_and_fill). Only categories whose fields actually feed state['doc_fields'] (see DOC_FIELD_MAP in data_gathering.py) belong here — ALTA/Purchase/MI/CD/URLA go through File Contacts, not doc_fields. Leaf paths come from real manifests (jobs a2643fae, 5469bfdf); dotted, arrays as '[]'. 'validator' is a key into shared/tasktile_validation.VALIDATORS ('present' if omitted). Only fields the bucket engine trusts (bucket 1) will actually fill; bucket 2/3 fields resolve to fallback and are skipped here.
